_readme: Supplier page details for Barbering Business, gathered 17 Nov 2026 from each company's own website (title, meta description, header logo). Where the site gave no usable logo, the logo is from the company's Wikimedia Commons file. dark:true means the logo is white and is shown on a dark tile. An empty website or logo means we could not confirm one: leave it empty rather than guess. Sector drives the filter on the hub.
